findings.note: The section-ordering assertion is vacuous if the heading disappears: strings.Index returns -1 when "## Verdict" is absent, and shardedAt is always >= 0 because the Contains check above already passed, so `shardedAt < verdictAt` can never fire on a log that lost its Verdict heading. Asserting verdictAt >= 0 first would make the check real.
